description: response.rs:339 calls JmapError::unknown_capability() in jmap_error_all_constructors_serialize without #[allow(deprecated)]. The commit added #[allow(deprecated)] in error.rs (same crate as the deprecated fn) but missed this cross-crate call site. cargo test -p jmap-server currently emits a deprecation warning; cargo test -p jmap-server -- -D warnings or clippy -D warnings will treat it as an error and break CI. Fix: add #[allow(deprecated)] to the jmap_error_all_constructors_serialize test function.
title: missing #[allow(deprecated)] on response.rs test using unknown_capability()
